notes.title: What's the Matter? is releasing on March 1st.
notes.notes: Finally an educational game that you'll want to play.  What's the Matter? is a twin stick shooter with rogue-lite elements releasing March 1st.  Play as Matty, a little bit of matter, as he goes on rescue missions throughout the universe.  Progress through the Periodic Table of Elements as you rescue your matter friends.  Features hand drawn graphics, original jazz tunes, and randomly generated levels.
